title: Run the approved five-source deep research cycle
objective: Produce comparable, evidence-linked mechanism studies for Notion, Linear, Stripe, ElevenLabs, and Ramp, then synthesise them without copying source signatures.

included: Current official public evidence for all five approved sources
Observed evidence, mechanisms, conventions, transfer principles, exclusions, and limitations
Independent source studies followed by one comparative synthesis
Candidate Mez hypotheses clearly labelled unapproved
excluded: Copied source tokens, assets, copy, components, or signature compositions
Promotion of hypotheses into canonical Mez rules

acceptance: All five source studies follow one comparable structure
Observed evidence and interpretation remain separate
Every candidate Mez hypothesis is unapproved and carries exclusions
Cross-source mechanisms answer the three priority questions
Conventions, distinctive mechanisms, gaps, tensions, and originality risks are explicit
The synthesis recommends experiments, not copied solutions

verification.passCondition: The approved five-source panel and research boundary pass.
Each source claim resolves to current official public evidence and is labelled by epistemic status.
No recommendation copies a source signature or promotes an external value directly into Mez.

stopConditions: Stop any claim that cannot resolve to current official public evidence.
Stop any translation that remains recognisably attributable to one source.
Do not begin H2 visual-direction production until the comparative synthesis and research gaps are reviewed.
notes: Sub-agents may research independent sources in parallel, but the primary agent owns normalization, comparison, validation, and the final synthesis.
